public_rationale: He says nobody 'appears' to be making a profit on renting out AI compute. That is a hedged impression. He gives no profit measure, no set of companies and no period. As context, CoreWeave, a US AI cloud company, reported a 2025 net loss of $1.17bn (e1). It reported a 2025 operating loss of $46m, after an operating profit of $324m in 2024 (e2). The same report gives CoreWeave's non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA for 2025 as $3.09bn (e1). These figures cover one firm, and its result differs by measure and by year. Grading the statement would mean choosing a measure, a company set and a period that he did not supply.
limitations: The context covers only one AI compute provider.
The record does not show AI compute rental profit or loss for any other provider, including large cloud companies.
No period is stated, and CoreWeave's results differ between 2024 and 2025.
